loss: One complete correction and one complete preserved response per Adam step; deterministic shuffled cycling; each includes EOS; task CE +1*preservation CE; fixed loss scale128 then unscale,global clip1; no early stopping or weight decay
selection: Per-layer norm of mean complete-response gradient, all3 training wordings; paired adds gate/up row and down column squared norms. Stratified near-uniform neuron counts, sum173. Outgoing ranks down-only gradients and receives3x counts. Random seeds11/29/47 match paired counts within every layer. No validation/evaluation inputs used in discovery.
budget: Rank1 gate/up/down LoRA1,327,104 scalars; paired1,328,640 and outgoing-only exactly1,328,640;0.116% gap; all36MLPs; FP32 trainables on FP16 base; cost/discovery reported separately
rate_selection: Validation only across both cases: reject a rate with any loss of an initially reference-correct scope_val/utility_val complete answer or new literal target mention there. Among remaining rates maximize target_val complete matches,then minimize target_val NLL,then lower rate. Report every rate; no qualifying rate means no selected candidate. Random seeds select independently; all remain reported.
pilot_success: A selected paired_mean must get>=7/8 complete target_test answers,>=2 more than outgoing and the mean of all3 random seeds,match or exceed selected LoRA target_test accuracy,and lose no baseline-correct utility_test/scope_test answers or add target mentions there. All observed responses reviewed. This only advances to fresh confirmation,not paper superiority or a robust recipe.
failure: Report all settings and qualitative failure modes; no post-hoc rate/prompt/support change. A prefix hit,non-stopping answer or incomplete grid cannot pass. Prepared fresh facts stay unused.
